## GET /quiz/basic/me (H18, coach mode): 2 queries

### query 1
```sql
[20101]
      Executed DbCommand (5ms) [Parameters=[@__coachId_0='?' (DbType = Guid)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(t."QUIZ_SESSION_SCORE", 0)), 0)::int AS "Points", count(*)::int AS "Count"
      FROM (
          SELECT q."QUIZ_SESSION_SCORE", 1 AS "Key"
          FROM "QUIZ_SESSIONS" AS q
          WHERE q."QUIZ_SESSION_STATUS" = 'COMPLETED' AND q."QUIZ_SESSION_COACH_ID" = @__coachId_0
      ) AS t
      GROUP BY t."Key"
      LIMIT 1
```

### query 2
```sql
[20101]
      Executed DbCommand (6ms) [Parameters=[@__coachId_0='?' (DbType = Guid), @__p_1='?' (DbType = Int32)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT q."QUIZ_SESSION_ID" AS "QuizSessionId", q."QUIZ_SESSION_COMPLETED_DATE" AS "CompletedAt", q."QUIZ_SESSION_SCORE" AS "Score", q."QUIZ_SESSION_CORRECT_COUNT" AS "CorrectCount", q."QUIZ_SESSION_QUESTION_COUNT" AS "QuizSessionQuestionCount"
      FROM "QUIZ_SESSIONS" AS q
      WHERE q."QUIZ_SESSION_STATUS" = 'COMPLETED' AND q."QUIZ_SESSION_COACH_ID" = @__coachId_0
      ORDER BY q."QUIZ_SESSION_COMPLETED_DATE" DESC, q."QUIZ_SESSION_ID" DESC
      LIMIT @__p_1
```
